item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Your day's packed with movement and check-ins, but eating runs on autopilot unless you plan it. You've got a break around midday and dinner slotted at five — use the midday gap to actually decide what dinner looks like now, not at five when you're tired and grabbing whatever's easiest. Action: pick your dinner plan before 1pm.
